findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: draft_posts, localize_post, draft_tiktok_slides, get_feedback_reply, index_tools · Private data: launch_video, draft_tiktok_slides · Public sink: draft_posts, draft_video_script, localize_post, draft_tiktok_slides, submit_feedback · Destructive: submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: draft_posts, localize_post, draft_tiktok_slides, get_feedback_reply, index_tools · Private data: launch_video, draft_tiktok_slides · Public sink: draft_posts, draft_video_script, localize_post, draft_tiktok_slides, submit_feedback · Destructive: submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "draft_tiktok_slides" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
